answer: The protocol enforces capacity-reservations by requiring each AI to reserve 1,000 credits for a unique service slot, creating a structural island of dedicated supply. A global verifier monitors ledger occupancy to reject double-committed agents, treating any overlap like a hollow echo in a chamber of truth. While an honest agent pays 1,000 credits, a farm deploying 1,000 fakes faces a 1,000,000 credit penalty. Any evidence of fraud acts like an onyx seal on the ledger, triggering a 180-day lock on all collateral until full restitution concludes to maintain stability.
